snippet.title: Delivery Driver Massacre - Definitive Edition Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Delivery Driver Massacre: Definitive Edition is officially live on Steam! Play as a delivery driver on a shift that goes horribly wrong. Low-poly 80s slasher horror, multiple endings, and a body count that keeps climbing.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4430910
📦 20% off for the first week only

#indiegame #horrorgame #indiedev #steam
